name: rudra-ai
description: Rudra AI - App-like Voice Assistant for Windows

scripts.dev: npm run build:electron && concurrently -k "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend" "npm run dev:electron"
scripts.build:backend: python backend/scripts/download_whisper.py && python -m PyInstaller backend/rudra-backend.spec --noconfirm --distpath backend/dist --workpath backend/build
scripts.build: npm run build:frontend && npm run build:electron
